name: Gradaly v4.2.0
title: Gradaly v4.2.0
notes:
### 🚀 New Features & Improvements
- **High-Speed Parallel Online Copy Synchronization**: Replaced sequential copy syncing with a hardware-aware 2-stage pipeline (multi-core CPU preparation pool + 10 concurrent HTTP/2 binary `application/octet-stream` upload streams), off-thread JPEG encoding, and KaTeX/MathJax caching, cutting sync times for large exams (600+ copies) by up to 8x.
- **Full 2D Keyboard Navigation & Fast Grading Shortcuts**: Navigate between copies/students (`↑` / `↓` or `K` / `J`) across all tabs, switch questions or PDF pages (`←` / `→` or `H` / `L`), toggle rubric criteria directly with number keys `1`–`9`, validate manually with `V`, and press `?` at any time to open the Keyboard Shortcuts cheat sheet.
- **High-DPI Scan Detection & One-Click 200 DPI Optimization**: Automatically detects scans above 220 DPI during import and offers native downscaling to 200 DPI to significantly reduce project size and speed up sharing and AI grading.
- **Resend Batch Email Delivery & Quota Diagnostics**: Upgraded student notification emails to use the Resend Batch API (up to 10x faster delivery for large cohorts) with precise quota/rate-limit diagnostics, Test/Dry-Run mode, and seamless resume for unsent recipients.
- **Faster Cloud Project Sharing & Large Archive Support**: Switched cloud project sharing to raw binary transfers (`application/octet-stream`) with 5 MB chunks, 4x parallel workers, automatic retry, and chunked IPC transfers supporting 400+ MB archives.
- **Question-Level Parallel AI Grading & Optional Anomaly Detection**: Parallelized AI evaluation across `(copy, question)` pairs with shared PDF caching, plus optional automatic detection and filtering of grading anomalies.
